render: painterly anime-inspired 2D mobile game art with crisp gameplay readability
background_rule: The center remains calm. Architecture and spectacle stay on the edges.
orb_rule: Every tier differs by radius, hue and numeric rune. Art radius must match collision radius.
character_rule: The same four-column portrait atlas is used for roster, selection and summon results.
fx_rule: Merge effects last less than 600 ms and never hide the loss line or next drop.
ui_rule: Portrait mobile, stable dimensions, minimum 44 CSS px touch targets, rates and pity always inspectable.
